name: @aipowersalon/observability
description: The observability kernel (Constitution 13 §80): structured redacted logging, the metrics registry, request/correlation ids and async context, build info, and the telemetry adapters (jobs, providers, database, Redis, realtime, HTTP requests). Health aggregation, SLOs, alerts and the System Operations surface stay in apps/api — they are the platform's operations DOMAIN, not the kernel.
